rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The supplement, dated Wednesday 30 December 1992, opens with Resolução nº 101, de 1992, promulgated by Mauro Benevides as President of the Senate and dated Senado Federal 30 December 1992: it declares the request for loss of office prejudiced by Fernando Affonso Collor de Mello's resignation, formalized before the National Congress, upholds the accusation, imposes on him disqualification ('inabilitação') for eight years from exercising public functions, and enters into force on the date of its publication.

locator.item: RESOLUÇÃO Nº 101, DE 1992, arts. 1-4 and dating line

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: At the Senate's session as a court on 29 December 1992 (opened at 9:00), defence counsel José Moura Rocha said he had just spoken by telephone with the suspended President Fernando Collor de Mello and read to the Senate Collor's letter to the President of the National Congress, dated Brasília 29 December 1992 and signed 'F. Collor', stating that on that date and by that instrument he resigns the mandate of President of the Republic. The President of Congress, Mauro Benevides, then convened a joint session for 11:30 that day, and Minister Sydney Sanches suspended the Senate session at 9:43 so that Congress could receive the resignation and declare the vacancy; it reopened at 13:40.

locator.item: attendance at 9:00 (p. 2729); Moura Rocha's reading of the letter, with its handwritten facsimile (p. 2738); Benevides's convocation (p. 2741); 'Suspensa às 9h43min, a sessão é reaberta às 13h40min' (p. 2742)

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: When the session resumed, the Senate voted on whether the process should continue after the resignation: the panel printout headed '29.12.92 18:17 HORAS', 'PROSSEGUIMENTO DO PROCESSO DE IMPEACHMENT', shows 71 yes and 8 no; Sanches declared that the Senate had decided by 71 votes to 8 that the process against Collor should continue to consider the sanction of disqualification ('inabilitação'), and after two senators declared votes not registered on the panel he proclaimed 73 yes and 8 no.

locator.item: vote panel '29.12.92 18:17 HORAS 2.SESSAO 1.VOTACAO'; the proclamations by Sydney Sanches

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The panel printout headed '30.12.92 04:21 HORAS', 'INABILITACAO POR OITO ANOS', records 76 yes, 3 no and no abstentions (total 79); Sanches announced the result, noting that abstention was not permitted, and read the sentence against Collor. The session rose at 4:40 on the following day, 30 December 1992.

locator.item: vote panel '30.12.92 04:21 HORAS 2.SESSAO 2.VOTACAO'; announcement of the result; closing line on PDF page 324 'Levanta-se a sessão às 4h40min do dia imediato'
